additional_info.subject: ID0475042-DC/Si-D/FR- [ MP/P0 170001112] Charging Station Issue CRM:03275000028
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0475042
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P0 170001112
Charger ID / Serial No.:
ovPnwz
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:  Screen detached-CHAdeMO cable dragged on the ground.
Following the client’s report, we noticed that the screen is peeling out of place. Please take the necessary action from your side to recover the screen; if this is not possible, proceed with a replacement.
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB, If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is OK: SCREENSHOT_DISPLAY_CONNECTION:
▹ Verify if the DP cable is properly attached If both are OK then replace the HMI
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger:
-8EM5902-1AA00-6AA0  Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/ AC cutout.
-8EM5902-1AA02-2AA7 Controlp. middle segm. with CCR cutout.
-8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6  Controlpanel Adaptation Set.
The cable  on the ground. As shown in the photos provided by the customer, the clamps are not in the correct position. Please ensure that the clamps are properly installed in the right position and that the cable is not touching or dragging on the floor.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
